subject: Transportation Systems
title: Lidar vs. Camera-Only
description: A fast breakdown of Lidar vs. Camera-Only for builders.

hook.text: The self-driving industry is split: some use laser scanners, others rely on cameras alone.

buildup.text: Lidar shoots millions of laser pulses per second, building a 3D point cloud of the environment.

discovery.text: Tesla bets on camera-only vision, arguing that if humans drive with eyes, cars can too—with enough AI.

twist.text: Lidar gives precise depth data but costs thousands per unit. Cameras are cheap but struggle with depth and glare.

climax.text: Waymo uses lidar and has the safest record. Tesla uses cameras and has the most cars. The debate rages.

punchline.text: Lasers or cameras? The answer will define autonomous driving.

quiz.question: What is the main advantage of lidar over cameras?
